description: Plugin registry — registerPlugin, unregisterPlugin, getPlugin, and getPlugins.

tests.description: registerPlugin stores a plugin and getPlugins returns it
tests.action: MU.registerPlugin({name: 'Reg Test', type: 'renderer', filename: 'reg-test.js'}); const entry = MU.getPlugins().find(m => m.name === 'Reg Test'); expect(entry).toBeDefined(); expect(entry.type).toBe('renderer'); expect(entry.filename).toBe('reg-test.js')

tests.description: getPlugins(type) returns only plugins matching type
tests.action: MU.registerPlugin({name: 'Exporter Test', type: 'exporter', filename: 'exporter-test.js'}); const entries = MU.getPlugins('exporter'); expect(entries.find(m => m.name === 'Exporter Test')).toBeDefined(); expect(entries.find(m => m.name === 'Reg Test')).toBeUndefined()

tests.description: getPlugin(name) returns the plugin with that name, or undefined if not found
tests.action: MU.registerPlugin({name: 'Solo Test', type: 'importer', filename: 'solo-test.js'}); const entry = MU.getPlugin('Solo Test'); expect(entry).toBeDefined(); expect(entry.type).toBe('importer'); expect(entry.filename).toBe('solo-test.js'); expect(MU.getPlugin('No Such Plugin')).toBeUndefined()

tests.description: unregisterPlugin removes the plugin from the registry
tests.action: MU.registerPlugin({name: 'Removable Test', type: 'renderer', filename: 'removable-test.js'}); MU.unregisterPlugin('Removable Test'); expect(MU.getPlugin('Removable Test')).toBeUndefined()
